changesets.name: fleet-github-http.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-fleet": patch
---

### Changed

- Fleet reads GitHub over HTTP through effect-github, using `GH_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, or the existing `gh auth token` login.
- Secondary GitHub rate limits without a retry time back off from one minute, doubling up to fifteen minutes until a successful response resets the wait.

changesets.name: github-app-auth.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-github": minor
---

### Added

- Authenticate GitHub REST requests as an App installation with built-in RS256 signing, repository installation lookup, and cached installation tokens shared across concurrent requests until their refresh point.
- Verify webhook signatures against raw bytes with HMAC SHA-256 and a constant-time comparison before decoding the delivery with the caller's Schema. Signature and App authentication failures stay typed and exclude credentials from errors and telemetry.

### Breaking

- `GitHubToken` may now contain a lazy Effect as well as a static Option. Consumers reading the service directly must resolve it with `Effect.isEffect(value) ? yield* value : value` before inspecting the Option. Existing `Layer.succeed(GitHubToken)` providers and `GitHubToken.fromEnv` need no changes.

changesets.name: pr-watch-github-client.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/pr-watch": minor
---

### Changed

- Send GitHub reads, queue-confirmation writes, conditional requests and Link pagination through effect-github. Keep polling slowdown and cooldown scheduling in the watcher, using shared resource observations and rate-limit retry instants. Permission failures retain the saved snapshot without imposing a quota cooldown.

### Breaking

- Provide effect-github’s `GitHub.layer` and `GitHubToken.fromEnv` when composing `GitHubHttp.layer`. Remove `Options.token` and the token arguments to `argumentsFor`, `program` and `GitHubHttp` methods; configure authentication through `GitHubToken` instead. `GitHubHttp.get` and `post` return decoded bodies, and `list` collects paginated bodies. Replace `httpResponse` helpers and `quota.observeBudget`/`Budget` with effect-github; `pollDelay` now accepts its rate-limit observations and an optional retry instant.

changesets.name: worker-release-handoff.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-sql": minor
"@shivaedev/effect-pg-boss": minor
"@shivaedev/platform": minor
"@shivaedev/create-app": minor
---

### Added

- effect-sql records the database release after successful migrations and coordinates worker drain with typed PostgreSQL heartbeat rows.
- effect-pg-boss pauses fetching while the database belongs to another release, finishes active jobs, and resumes when its release owns the database again.
- Platform migration options accept an optional `release` for deployment migration and worker readiness.
- Generated workers step aside for a newer release and drain on SIGTERM, with queue expiry, stop timeout and Railway draining configured together.
